name: starglass_flight
notes: A faceted star-glass splinter (34x11 px, ~0.9 m) spinning about its long axis (facets catch the light in turn), a lit needle tip, hard 4-point glints flicking off the top facets on alternate beats, a thin trail of blinking glass glitter. Construct palette (cyan/white glass, navy edge). Anchor = shard centre.
